newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian guard kills attacking tiger - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Russian guard kills attacking tiger - Interfax.

text.p: A Russian border guard killed a rare tiger who attacked him at the remote Far East outpost known as Tigrovaya, or Tiger Post, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.

The hungry young animal first tried to attack frontier guard dogs kept in cages, but after failing to break in, the tiger switched its attack to the guard, who shot and killed it with his machine gun.
Fewer than 500 Siberian tigers roam the forests of the Russian Far East, including around 100 young ones. The Siberian tiger is the largest of the surviving five tiger species.
They are known for attacking humans when they are hungry.
